notes: §1985:XII.3.4 GR8: "Debugging lines are permitted in pseudo-text. Text words within a debugging line participate in the matching rules as if the 'D' did not appear in the indicator area", and the mode is decided only after REPLACE (§1985:VI.7.3 "After all COPY and REPLACE statements have been processed, a debugging line will be considered to have all the characteristics of a comment line"). FixedFormConverter emits a D line as DebugLineCarrier plus its text, TextWordScanner.TryNext skips the carrier (DebugLineCarrier.StartsAt) and scans the text, so ApplyReplacements matches the line's words whatever the WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause later says. Witness: ==MOVE 1 / D TO X== matches MOVE 1 TO X without the mode (2). Probes (classes b, d): the same with WITH DEBUGGING MODE (g8a: 2); a D line in pseudo-text-2 is kept as a debugging line, comment without the mode (g8b: 2) and source with it (g8c: 3); a source D line is matched before the mode is applied (g8d, g8e: 2; g8g keeps the replacement on its D line). retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Preprocessor/TextWord.cs#IsDebugLineCarrierAt (the member moved under a new name (kb/Work PB2421: PictureConstructId is PicInfo.ConstructId; kb/Work PB2409: the carrier test is DebugLineCarrier.StartsAt); the same code) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Preprocessor/ReferenceFormatProcessor.LogicalConversion.cs#FixedFormConverter (the extract of ReferenceFormatProcessor (kb/Work PB2328): the member moved verbatim to the file of the type that holds it now (LogicalLineConverter, FixedFormConverter, FreeFormConverter, LogicalLineBuilder); the same code)

next.reason: 2023 has no debugging lines: the fixed indicators of §2023:6.2.2 are comment, continuation and the space 'source indicator' only, and §2023:6.5 GR5 copies only a line that 'contains a source indicator'. No 2023 rule permits 'D' lines in REPLACE pseudo-text or makes their words match 'as if the D did not appear'.
